title: Bacon SMP
description: The Bacon SMP is a mod that introduces custom weapons and a redstone-powered string duper to the game. The custom weapons are crafted from valuable materials. This mod is still in development. There are many bugs.
body:
The Bacon SMP Mod is an all-in-one survival expansion designed to turn standard gameplay into a high-stakes economy and combat experience. This mod introduces a custom currency system, powerful legendary weapons, unique automated machines, and structural enhancements for your world.
**Current Features

**Bacon Economy: Kill other players to steal their "Bacon" currency. Deposit/Withdraw your balance via command to secure your wealth in the mod's database.

**Custom Weapons
Obsidian Crusher: Right-click to drop a massive 8x8 platform of obsidian that crushes entities with 3x suffocation damage.
Magma Cinderblade: Right-click to launch Lava and Primed TNT at your target. Grants Fire Resistance upon slaying a player.
Thunder-Strike Polearm: Right-click to auto-aim lightning at the nearest player or entity you are facing. Deals 2x damage and reloads instantly.
Gale Bow: Fires arrows that create levitation effects on hit and carve permanent tunnels through blocks in their flight path.
Automation: The String Duper block automatically produces string until you toggle it off with a Redstone signal (like a lever).
The Dragon's Breath Cannon: A specialized stationary turret that automatically identifies nearby entities (prioritizing players) and fires dragon fireballs at them.
Team System: Create your own teams, invite members, set home teleports, manage warps, and use dedicated team chat.
Utility Commands: Utilize /spawn, /rtp, /ah (Auction House), /trade, and a robust /tpa system.

**Known Issues & Status
Textures: Currently, custom item and block icons are not rendering correctly in-game (appearing as missing-texture blocks). I am in the process of debugging the resource-loading pipeline.

Silk Touch Spawners: The functionality to mine and pick up spawners using Silk Touch is currently non-functional and is slated for an upcoming patch.

This description was made with the use of AI. The mod is unfinished and will be updated for a full release soon fixing the biggest bugs in the mod and adding new weapons. Enjoy!
